WITH pages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1402138.5184246691'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    page_location,
    page_title,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') AS segments
  FROM pages
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    page_location,
    page_title,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) AS num_segments,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '') AS seg4,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '') AS seg5,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 1, segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments)-1)], '') AS last_seg,
    (LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%accessories%' 
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%apparel%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%brands%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%campus+collection%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%drinkware%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%electronics%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%google+redesign%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%lifestyle%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%nest%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%new+2015+logo%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%notebooks+journals%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%office%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%shop+by+brand%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%small+goods%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%stationery%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], '')) LIKE '%wearables%') AS seg4_has_category,
    (LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%accessories%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%apparel%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%brands%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%campus+collection%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%drinkware%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%electronics%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%google+redesign%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%lifestyle%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%nest%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%new+2015+logo%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%notebooks+journals%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%office%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%shop+by+brand%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%small+goods%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%stationery%'
     OR LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, segments[OFFSET(5)], '')) LIKE '%wearables%') AS seg5_has_category,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, INSTR(segments[OFFSET(4)], '+') > 0, FALSE) AS seg4_has_plus,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 6, INSTR(segments[OFFSET(5)], '+') > 0, FALSE) AS seg5_has_plus,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 1, INSTR(segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments)-1)], '+') > 0, FALSE) AS last_has_plus
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT
  page_title AS page_name,
  CASE
    WHEN num_segments >= 5 
      AND (seg4_has_category OR seg5_has_category)
      AND INSTR(last_seg, '+') > 0
    THEN 'PDP'
    WHEN num_segments >= 5
      AND (seg4_has_category OR seg5_has_category)
      AND NOT seg4_has_plus
      AND NOT seg5_has_plus
    THEN 'PLP'
    ELSE page_title
  END AS page_type
FROM classified
ORDER BY page_type

### Refined Page Classification Criteria

#### Overview
To enhance our understanding of user engagement on our e-commerce platform, we differentiate between two types of pages based on the URL structure: Product Listing Pages (PLPs) and Product Detail Pages (PDPs). These classifications are crucial for analyzing user behavior and improving site navigation efficiency.

#### Product Listing Pages (PLPs)
PLPs are identified by specific characteristics in the URL:
- The URL must be divided into at least five segments.
- Neither the fourth nor the fifth segment contains a '+' sign, ensuring these are not detail views.
- The fourth or fifth segment must contain one of the following category names, indicating a broader category or collection page rather than a specific product focus:
  - Accessories
  - Apparel

#### Product Detail Pages (PDPs)
PDPs, which focus on individual products, are marked by:
- A URL split into at least five segments, akin to PLPs.
- The presence of a '+' sign in the last segment, a common marker for detailed product pages.
- The fourth or fifth segment must also include one of the specified category names, ensuring that the detail being viewed pertains to one of the recognized product categories:
